info.title: APICenter API
info.description: Consumer HTTP API for payments, messaging, verification, geolocation and Google sign-in. Every call authenticates with an application key.

post.description: Confirms an intent with a payment method created through the payment provider's client-side step, which your frontend must run. Prefer checkouts, payment links, QR Ph or wallet-redirect intents, which need nothing from the provider in your application.

201.description: QR Ph payment intent created; awaiting_next_action is not confirmation of payment.

200.description: Payment links owned by the calling project
Plans owned by the calling project

get.description: Payees of the calling project, newest first. Requires payments:payouts:read.

post.description: Registers a payee: someone the project pays out of its payments. Idempotent per externalRef: repeating it returns the existing payee with 200. Requires payments:payouts:write.

200.description: A payee with this externalRef already exists

get.description: A payee with its earnings. Requires payments:payouts:read.

put.description: Sets where the payee is paid: a GCash or bank account through InstaPay, or a wallet at the payment provider. A new destination holds payouts to the payee for 24 hours; sending the same destination again does not restart the hold. Requires payments:payouts:write.

200.description: Destination set; the account number is returned masked

put.description: Records a verification performed by the project. Requires payments:payouts:write.

get.description: Reads the current wallet onboarding status in test. Requires payments:payouts:read.

post.description: Starts or resumes wallet onboarding in test. A newly issued hosted link is returned once. Availability: test-only pilot, coming soon; not enabled by default. While it is off, this returns 503 PAYEE_ONBOARDING_DISABLED. Requires payments:payouts:write.

Issues a fresh hosted verification link in test. Use a new idempotency key to request a new link. Availability: test-only pilot, coming soon; not enabled by default. While it is off, this returns 503 PAYEE_ONBOARDING_DISABLED. Requires payments:payouts:write.

Requests wallet activation after identity verification in test. Availability: test-only pilot, coming soon; not enabled by default. While it is off, this returns 503 PAYEE_ONBOARDING_DISABLED. Requires payments:payouts:write.

Pays the payee's released earnings now, whole allocations oldest first, up to what is left of the daily cash-out cap. The payee bears the transfer fee unless the project chose otherwise. A refusal is 409 with code DESTINATION_HOLD, NO_DESTINATION, BELOW_CASH_OUT_MINIMUM, DAILY_CAP_REACHED, ON_DEMAND_DISABLED, PAYEE_NOT_VERIFIED or NOTHING_RELEASED. Availability: sending payouts is coming soon. Until it opens for an environment, cash-out is refused with 409 PAYOUTS_LIVE_DISABLED (live) or WALLET_NOT_CONFIGURED; payees, allocations and earnings are recorded in the meantime. Requires payments:payouts:write.

202.description: Payout submitted; payment.payout.paid or payment.payout.failed follows

post.description: Releases a held share so it is paid in the payee's next payout. Call it when your own completion rule is met. A share that is not held is 409 INVALID_ALLOCATION_STATE. Requires payments:payouts:write.
Cancels a share that has not been paid out, for example when the work was not done. A share already pooled or paid is 409 INVALID_ALLOCATION_STATE. Requires payments:payouts:write.

get.description: Payouts of the calling project, newest first. Availability: payouts appear here once sending payouts opens for the environment (coming soon). Requires payments:payouts:read.

get.description: Returns the application, project, organization and environment a key belongs to, and its grants. Use it to check a key after setup.

401.description: The key is missing, invalid, expired or revoked

ApplicationKey.description: An application key (ak_test_… or ak_live_…). The key alone identifies the application, its project and its environment; each call needs a grant for its action.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Unique key for safely retrying this payment mutation. Reuse the same key and request body after uncertain outcomes. A key used with a different request, an in-progress request, or an unresolved provider outcome returns HTTP 409.

PayeeOnboardingResponse.description: Wallet onboarding status. Replays return the recorded result with verification set to null.

IdempotencyConflict.description: The key was used with a different request, is already processing, or the provider outcome remains unresolved. Inspect `error.code`; in particular, `PAYMENT_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN` requires reconciliation before using a new key.

Unauthorized.description: The application key is missing, malformed, revoked or expired (`UNAUTHORIZED`, `CREDENTIAL_REVOKED`, `CREDENTIAL_EXPIRED`). Do not retry.

Forbidden.description: The application lacks a grant for this action, or the capability, environment, project or organization is not enabled (`ACTION_NOT_GRANTED`, `CAPABILITY_NOT_ENABLED`, `ENVIRONMENT_INACTIVE`, `LIVE_PLAN_REQUIRED`). Do not retry.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests (`RATE_LIMITED`, `PAYMENT_RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`) or the environment's quota is used up (`QUOTA_EXCEEDED`). Retry after `Retry-After` seconds, except for `QUOTA_EXCEEDED`, which lasts until the quota window resets.

ServerError.description: An unexpected failure in APICenter (`INTERNAL_ERROR`). Retry writes only with the same idempotency key.

UpstreamFailure.description: The payment provider failed or did not answer in time (`BAD_GATEWAY`, `UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT`, `PAYMENT_UPSTREAM_UNREACHABLE`). Retry writes only with the same idempotency key.

ServiceUnavailable.description: APICenter is busy or restarting (`DATABASE_BUSY`, `DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE`, `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`). Retry after `Retry-After` seconds.

amountMinor.description: Final gross amount in minor PHP units.

AllocationInput.description: A payee's share of the payment, at most 5,000,000 minor units (one InstaPay transfer). The shares may not add up to more than the payment.

Allocation.description: A payee's share of one payment. awaiting_payment until the payment is confirmed, then held until you release it.

externalRef.description: Your own identifier for the payee. Payout events carry it as referenceId.

legalName.description: The name on the payee's account. A mismatch is the most common reason a transfer fails.

bic.description: The receiving institution's code, for example GXCHPHM2XXX for GCash.

oneOf.description: A wallet at APICenter's payment provider.
Deprecated; the same as wallet. Accepted until 2027-03-01, then rejected.

PayeeDestination.description: The payee's destination as APICenter returns it; the account number is masked.

type.description: provider_wallet is deprecated and appears only for destinations set with it; it means wallet.

reference.description: Project verification record identifier. Never use an identity document number.

destinationHoldUntil.description: Payouts to the payee wait until this time after a destination change.

additionalPayouts.description: Additional transfers when released earnings span merchant accounts.

Payout.description: One transfer of a payee's pooled earnings.

status.description: unknown and needs_review mean APICenter is confirming the transfer with the payment provider; it is never sent twice.

failureCode.description: Why the payout failed: insufficient_funds, invalid_destination, rate_limited, wallet_not_configured, rejected, failed or not_submitted. An open set.

allocations.description: Payee shares of this payment, each at most the payment's amount in total. Each share is held when the payment is paid and paid out after you release it.

successUrl.description: An HTTPS link, or your app's own link such as myapp://booking/123. APICenter forwards to an app link from an HTTPS page it hosts.

cancelUrl.description: An HTTPS link, or your app's own link. APICenter forwards to an app link from an HTTPS page it hosts.

paymentMethods.description: Limits the checkout page to these methods. Each must be enabled for the environment (see getPaymentCapabilities). Defaults to card, gcash and paymaya.

metadata.description: Consumer-owned correlation metadata. Do not include secrets.

PaymentIntentCreateRequest.description: Send paymentMethod and returnUrl together to open that wallet directly; the response's nextAction.redirectUrl takes the customer straight to it. Leave both out for an intent you confirm yourself.

allocations.description: Payee shares of this payment, each at most the payment's amount in total. Each share is held when the payment is paid and paid out after you release it.

paymentMethod.description: The wallet to open. Requires returnUrl.

returnUrl.description: Where the wallet sends the customer afterwards, paid or not. An HTTPS link, or your app's own link; APICenter forwards to an app link from an HTTPS page it hosts. Requires paymentMethod.

paymentMethodId.description: Payment method ID created through the provider's client-side payment flow.

clientKey.description: Client key returned for this payment intent.
Short-lived client key for client-side operations on this payment intent; not a secret API key.

paymentMethod.description: Set on a wallet payment intent.

lastPaymentError.description: Why the last payment attempt failed, when status is failed.

code.description: A neutral decline reason: insufficient_funds, card_expired, invalid_card_details, card_declined, authentication_failed, cancelled_by_payer, processor_unavailable or other. An open set.

deprecatedProviderCode.description: The payment provider's own failure code. Returned until 2027-03-01; use code instead.

paymentMethods.description: The methods enabled for this environment. Hide any method that is not listed.

details.description: Extra facts about the error. Payment errors that come from the payment provider carry a neutral reason; rate limits carry retryAfter in seconds.

reason.description: Why a payment was declined: insufficient_funds, card_expired, invalid_card_details, card_declined, authentication_failed, cancelled_by_payer, processor_unavailable or other. An open set.

deprecatedProviderCode.description: The payment provider's own error code. Returned until 2027-03-01 for integrations that matched provider codes; use the error code and reason instead.

allocations.description: Payee shares of this payment, each at most the payment's amount in total. Each share is held when the payment is paid and paid out after you release it.

metadata.description: String values only. APICenter sets apicenter_reference_id to referenceId.

status.description: active or archived, or paid once the payment provider reports a payment for the link.

referenceNumber.description: Reference number shown to the payer for this link.

status.description: awaiting_next_action means the QR code is ready, not that payment is complete.

anyOf.description: A nonempty address string. Legacy recipient objects containing email are also accepted; syntax is not validated by the runtime.

items.description: A nonempty address string. Legacy recipient objects containing email are also accepted; syntax is not validated by the runtime.

provider.description: Which email source handled the message. Returned until 2027-03-01.
Which email source handled the message. Returned until 2027-03-01.

target.description: Legacy fallback when recipient is absent.

purpose.description: Accepted correlation purpose; does not change verification behavior.

digits.description: Requested length; runtime coerces numeric values and clamps the effective length to 4–10.

ttlSeconds.description: Requested lifetime; runtime clamps the effective lifetime to 60–3600 seconds.

code.description: Returned only in explicitly configured nonproduction mock mode.

resultType.description: A geocoding-provider result filter. Honoured until 2027-03-01, then ignored.

locationType.description: A geocoding-provider precision filter. Honoured until 2027-03-01, then ignored.

precision.description: How exactly the coordinates locate the address: exact, street, area or approximate. An open set.

placeId.description: The geocoding provider's place identifier. Returned until 2027-03-01; use the coordinates and components.

types.description: The geocoding provider's result types. Returned until 2027-03-01; use precision.

provider.description: Which geocoding source answered. Returned until 2027-03-01.

raw.description: The geocoding provider's unprocessed result. Returned until 2027-03-01; use components.

GeoAddressComponents.description: The parts of a Philippine address. A part the source does not know is omitted.

fences.description: An absent or empty array uses the configured default Metro Manila circle.

redirectUri.description: Must match a registered project/environment redirect. Defaults to the first registered redirect.

x-apicenter-excluded-routes.reason: Mock-only implementation; not exposed by the service manifest or supported SDK.
Provider callbacks use separate verification and are not consumer commands.
